steps.message: Delete all but one of any expenses in pro expense that are exact duplicates, ensuring at least one instance of each unique expense remains.
Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i expense

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i expense"
